author: Foundry
description: The Advanced section: an HTML id, classes, custom CSS and attributes the site author sets per placed instance.

controls.title: Declare it at the top level
controls.body: {"type": "advanced"} takes no id and no options, and sits directly in inspector, never inside a section. It renders as the Advanced section at the bottom of this Inspector.

controls.title: ID
controls.body: An anchor for in-page links. Checked for uniqueness across the page and emitted as the root element's id through {{ part.attributes }}. Try "pricing".

controls.title: Classes
controls.body: Space-separated class names appended to the root through {{ part.class }}. This sheet styles two of its own: try "fx-accent" or "fx-outline".

controls.title: CSS
controls.body: The author's own CSS, nested inside this instance's selector so it cannot reach outside the part. Bare declarations style the root; nested rules such as .fx-target { background: gold; } style descendants; :hover attaches to the root. No template macro is needed.

controls.title: Attributes
controls.body: Name/value pairs such as data-… or ARIA attributes, emitted through {{ part.attributes }}. Add one with the Add Attribute… button. Try data-theme = dark to restyle the box below.
